  <style>

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; user-select: none; }

    :root {

    /* ================= 顶端切换条 ================= */

    /* ================= 视口结构 ================= */
    .tabletop-viewport {
      width: 100%;
      height: 860px;

      position: relative;
      display: none;
      /* 3D 透视内联到 .table-surface 的 transform（perspective()），避免与 zoom 重排冲突导致卡牌反旋失效/陷入桌面 */

        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--light-primary) 1.5px, transparent 2px),

  /* ================= 陌生系数（§5.7 前半） ================= */
  function unfOf(fam, cIn, r) {

  }

   * tuned = 已装槽的固定回路 [{id,名,params,budget}]（宿主过滤后传入）

  function findTuned(ctx, r, cIn) {

    if (curKey(c) !== '1-1' || c.fmed !== 0) return null;

    }
    return null;
  }

  /* ================= 总装：报价（§3.1-②A 的完整一次执行） =================
   * req.固定（可选）：true = 本次施放的是固化回路（type==='fixed'，肌肉记忆），精神账单 ×TUNE.fixedMindMul。
   *   自由/现构回路不要传（默认 false）——忘了传只会让固定回路贵 5 倍，不会让自由回路变便宜。 */
  function quote(req, ctx) {
    const r = calcCircuit(req, ctx);
    const ch = ctx.char || {};
    const im = injuryMod(ch.body);
    const U = unfOf(req.fam, r.c, r);
    const tuned = findTuned(ctx, r, r.c);
    let mind = Math.max(0.5, r.mind * U.unf * im.mM);
    let bill = r.bill * im.eM;
    // v2.3 固定回路（肌肉记忆/固化）：由宿主按回路 type==='fixed' 在 req.固定 声明 → 精神 ×TUNE.fixedMindMul。
    // 与 findTuned 的 ×0.3 不叠加（固定回路本身就常落在自己的微调预算内，叠加会双重打折）。
    if (req.固定) mind = Math.max(0.5, mind * TUNE.fixedMindMul);
    else if (tuned) mind = Math.max(0.5, mind * 0.3);
    mind = +mind.toFixed(1); bill = Math.round(bill * 10) / 10;
    const exhaust = bill > (ch.eCur ?? Infinity);
    // 过载率用"真实做功功率"（out/relT；引信类回路用 workOut），不用含门控/伤势损耗溢价的账单功率（避免全陌三重惩罚）
    const power = ((r.workOut ?? r.out) || 0.1) / r.relT;

    // 实际做功能量（磨炼统计口径）：引信类=点火费；其余=剥除门控倍率后的实付能量。
    // 介质折价保留（借来的力不算自己的磨炼），倍率溢价绝不计入——否则倍率越高刷得越快（正反馈错误）。
    const workE = r.workOut != null ? r.workOut : Math.round((r.bill / (r.g.e || 1)) * 10) / 10;
    const burst = ch.burstKW ?? 300, sus = ch.sustainKW ?? 50;
    const overBurst = power > burst, overSustain = r.relT >= 1 && power > sus;
    const mMax = ch.mMax ?? 90, mCur = ch.mCur ?? 90;
    const frac = mind / mMax;
    const zone = frac < 1 / 3 ? { n: '绿·轻度', c: 'g' } : frac < 2 / 3 ? { n: '黄·中度', c: 'y' } : frac < 0.9 ? { n: '红·重荷', c: 'r' } : { n: '紫·断线区', c: 'p' };
    let tell = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(r.tell + (r.g.t === 'far' ? 1 : 0))));

    /* ── 过载率（无上限）：短脉冲比爆发线，长脉冲比持续线；引信类回路（workOut）点火是瞬发动作，恒比爆发线 ── */
    const 基准线 = r.workOut != null ? (burst || 1) : (r.relT >= 1 ? (sus || 1) : (burst || 1));
    const overloadRate = +((power / 基准线) * 100).toFixed(1);

    /* 精神状态因子 */
    const safeMMax = Math.max(1, mMax);
    const P = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mCur / safeMMax));   // 当前精神比例 0~1
    const beta = Math.pow(100 / safeMMax, 0.5);            // 精神上限底蕴系数（100 标准=1）
    const gamma = 0.8 + (1 - P) * 1.2;                     // 疲劳系数 0.8~2.0
    const omegaMental = 0.6 + 1.4 * Math.pow(1 - P, 2);    // 认知精力压制曲线 0.6~2.0

    /* 模块 A：瞬时功率过载冲击 Φ_power = f(R) × β × γ */
    let fR = 0;

    else if (overloadRate > 100) fR = 5 + (overloadRate - 100) * 0.6;
    else if (overloadRate > 80) fR = (overloadRate - 80) * 0.25;
    const phiPower = fR * beta * gamma;

    /* 模块 B：认知壁垒反噬 Φ_barrier = D_base × β × Ω(P)（亲和 + 陌生） */
    const affinityPenalty = r.g.t === 'far' ? 18 : r.g.t === 'mid' ? 6 : 0;

    let rawBarrier = affinityPenalty + unfPenalty;

    const phiBarrier = rawBarrier * beta * omegaMental;

    /* 模块 C：生理与条款硬性代价 Φ_body（不受精神抵消） */
    const chips = r.chips.slice();
    const chipSum = r.chips.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.w || 0), 0);
    const phiBody = chipSum + im.sev * 5 + (exhaust ? 20 : 0);

    /* 过载风险（0-100） */
    const risk = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(phiPower + phiBarrier + phiBody)));

    /* 展示用的状态 chips（伤势/超爆发/超持续/高负荷/精神不足——w 仅展示，不计分） */
    if (im.sev) chips.push({ t: '伤势[' + (ch.body || '正常') + '] 精神×' + im.mM.toFixed(2) + ' 能量×' + im.eM.toFixed(2), w: 0, l: 'y' });

    if (overBurst) chips.push({ t: '超爆发上限' + burst + 'kW·断线', w: 0, l: 'r' });
    if (frac >= 2 / 3) chips.push({ t: '负荷区≥⅔·手抖冷汗视线发毛', w: 0, l: 'r' });
    if (mind > mCur) chips.push({ t: '精神余量不足·失败形态由裁判挑', w: 0, l: 'r' });
    if (exhaust) chips.push({ t: '储量透支·过载灼伤烧在接触处', w: 0, l: 'r' });

    return { r, E_out: r.out, bill, mind, workE, relT: r.relT, readyT: r.readyT, power, tell, risk, zone,
      overloadRate, beta, gamma,
      unf: U, chips, tunedHit: tuned ? tuned.id : null, tunedName: tuned ? (tuned['名'] || tuned.name) : null,
      exhaust, overBurst, overSustain };

  function updateSlotUseButtons() {
    for (var i = 0; i < slotsContainer.children.length; i++) {
      var btn = document.getElementById('useBtn_' + i);
      if (!btn) continue;
      var c = ON_DESK_CARDS.find(function (x) { return x.slotIndex === i; });
      var used = c ? !!opsUsedSet[c.id] : false;
      // 使用后变灰：圈选的卡牌 + 槽位都不发光
      if (c) {
        var cardEl = document.querySelector('#surfaceDesk1 .card-token[data-id="' + c.id + '"]');
        if (cardEl) cardEl.classList.toggle('used', used);
        var sock = document.getElementById('socket_' + i);
        if (sock) sock.classList.toggle('used', used);
      }
      if (manualOps && c) {   // 手操模式 + 该槽有卡：可圈选（送审在确认时再拦）
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = used ? '● 已用' : '○ 使用';
        btn.style.opacity = used ? '0.55' : '1';
        btn.style.borderColor = used ? '#c6ff00' : '';
      } else if (c) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '○ 使用';
        btn.style.opacity = '0.35';
      } else {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '—';
        btn.style.opacity = '0.2';
      }

  function buildSlots() {
    slotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    var total = FIXED_CAP + FREE_CAP;
    for (var i = 0; i < total; i++) {
      var socket = document.createElement('div');
      socket.className = 'slot-socket ' + (i < FIXED_CAP ? 'is-fixed' : 'is-free');
      socket.id = 'socket_' + i;
      var isFree = i >= FIXED_CAP;

  var CARD_W = 136, CARD_H = 206;   // 卡牌尺寸（贴合：卡在 slot-well 内居中）
  // 槽位锚点（写死）：只在初始化/布局变化时算一次，之后进槽的卡一律用这份整数坐标。
  // 不随每次渲染重算 → 缩放/平移后再重渲染卡片位置不变（修掉「缩放后漂移 / 向右下偏」）。
  function computeSocketAnchors() {
    SOCKET_COORDS.length = 0;
    var surfaceRect = surfaceDesk1.getBoundingClientRect();
    for (var i = 0; i < slotsContainer.children.length; i++) {
      var sock = document.getElementById('socket_' + i);
      if (!sock) continue;
      var well = sock.querySelector('.slot-well');
      var r = well ? well.getBoundingClientRect() : sock.getBoundingClientRect();
      SOCKET_COORDS.push({
        x: Math.round((r.left - surfaceRect.left) / zoom1 + (r.width / zoom1 - CARD_W) / 2),
        y: Math.round((r.top - surfaceRect.top) / zoom1 + (r.height / zoom1 - CARD_H) / 2),
        index: i
      });
    }
    // 送审槽锚点（独立 socket，不进 numeric 索引；与槽位锚点同口径写死）
    var revSock = document.getElementById('socket_review');
    if (revSock) {
      var revWell = revSock.querySelector('.slot-well');
      var rr = revWell ? revWell.getBoundingClientRect() : revSock.getBoundingClientRect();
      REVIEW_ANCHOR.x = Math.round((rr.left - surfaceRect.left) / zoom1 + (rr.width / zoom1 - CARD_W) / 2);
      REVIEW_ANCHOR.y = Math.round((rr.top - surfaceRect.top) / zoom1 + (rr.height / zoom1 - CARD_H) / 2);
    }
    // 删除槽锚点（独立 socket，不进 numeric 索引；与槽位锚点同口径写死）
    var delSock = document.getElementById('socket_delete');
    if (delSock) {
      var delWell = delSock.querySelector('.slot-well');
      var dr = delWell ? delWell.getBoundingClientRect() : delSock.getBoundingClientRect();
      DELETE_ANCHOR.x = Math.round((dr.left - surfaceRect.left) / zoom1 + (dr.width / zoom1 - CARD_W) / 2);
      DELETE_ANCHOR.y = Math.round((dr.top - surfaceRect.top) / zoom1 + (dr.height / zoom1 - CARD_H) / 2);
    }
    // 补给匣已移至送审/销毁之间（recycle-row 流内布局），无需锚点定位
  }

    // 预设回路：直接免审入库（系统内置完整参数，不送审）
    if (FORGE_STATE.preset) {
      var p = FORGE_STATE.preset;
      var params0 = E.syncParams(p.fam, FORGE_STATE.c);
      writeGame(function (gg) {
        var qq = E.quote({ fam: p.fam, e: p.e, c: params0 }, forgeCtx());
        gg.回路库.push({
          id: nextFreeId(gg), 名称: p.name, type: 'free',
          族: E.FAMKEY[p.fam], famKey: p.fam,
          分支: E.branchOf(p.fam, params0),
          实体: p.fam === 'flow' ? String(E.curKey(params0)) : null,
          参数向量: params0, 注册e: p.fam === 'flow' ? 0 : p.e,
          参数明细: E.readableParams(p.fam, params0),
          微调预算: null, 微调预算明细: null,
          基线账单: { 输出kJ: qq.E_out, 计费kJ: qq.bill, 精神: qq.mind, 一句话效果: p.effect },
          uses: 0, 来源: '开局预设',
          审核存档: null, 审核状态: '免审'
        });
      });
      loadFromSave(); renderDesktopCards(); renderRepoList();
      openSidebar(); switchTab('tabRepo');
      alert('预设回路《' + p.name + '》已入自由库（免审）。');
      return;
    }

    var desc = intentDesc.value.trim();
    if (desc.length < 8) { alert('构筑意图描述太短：至少写清"作用对象 + 作用方式"（≥8字）。'); return; }
    var q = recalcForgeQuote();
    var params = E.syncParams(FORGE_STATE.fam, FORGE_STATE.c);

    var aff = affinityOf(g);
    var fmtAff = function (b) { return (b && b.族 ? b.族 : '') + '·' + (b && b.分支 ? b.分支 : ''); };
    var vars = {
      描述: desc,
      参数: JSON.stringify({ 族: FORGE_STATE.fam, 参数明细: E.readableParams(FORGE_STATE.fam, params), 引擎参考效果: String(q.r.effect || '') }, null, 1),
      亲和: '主分支：' + (aff.main.map(fmtAff).join('、') || '无') + '；次分支：' + (aff.subs.map(fmtAff).join('、') || '无'),
      场景: '风力' + g.场景.风力档 + '，无机物' + g.场景.可塑无机物kJ + 'kJ，水体' + (g.场景.水体在场 ? '有' : '无')
    };

    generateRaw({
      ordered_prompts: assembleSpell(getSpellPrompt(), vars),
      should_stream: false, should_silence: true,
      generation_id: 'gb_spell_desk_' + Date.now(),
      custom_api: getSpellApi(),
      json_schema: { name: 'spell_review', value: { type: 'object', properties: { 结论: { type: 'string', enum: ['通过', '驳回'] }, 规范化回路: { type: ['object', 'null'], properties: { 名称: { type: 'string' }, 一句话效果: { type: 'string' }, 物理相态与表征: { type: 'string' }, 效果文字稿: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['名称', '一句话效果'], additionalProperties: false }, 解释: { type: ['string', 'null'] } }, required: ['结论', '规范化回路', '解释'], additionalProperties: false } }
    }).then(function (raw) {
      var text = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : JSON.stringify(raw);
      var m = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); var json = null;
      try { json = JSON.parse(m ? m[0] : text); } catch (e) {}
      if (json && json.结论 === '通过' && json.规范化回路) {
        var name = String(json.规范化回路.名称 || desc.slice(0, 7) + '·自创').slice(0, 10);
        var effect = String(json.规范化回路.一句话效果 || q.r.effect || '');
        writeGame(function (gg) {
          var qq = E.quote({ fam: FORGE_STATE.fam, e: FORGE_STATE.e, c: params }, forgeCtx());
          gg.回路库.push({
            id: nextFreeId(gg), 名称: name, type: 'free',
            族: E.FAMKEY[FORGE_STATE.fam], famKey: FORGE_STATE.fam,
            分支: E.branchOf(FORGE_STATE.fam, params),
            实体: FORGE_STATE.fam === 'flow' ? String(E.curKey(params)) : null,
            参数向量: params, 注册e: FORGE_STATE.fam === 'flow' ? 0 : FORGE_STATE.e,
            参数明细: E.readableParams(FORGE_STATE.fam, params),
            微调预算: null, 微调预算明细: null,
            基线账单: { 输出kJ: qq.E_out, 计费kJ: qq.bill, 精神: qq.mind, 一句话效果: effect },
            // 正文AI 叙事唯一形态锚点（法术AI 按五系机理提炼）
            物理相态与表征: String(json.规范化回路.物理相态与表征 || ''),
            uses: 0, 来源: '面板送审',
            审核存档: { 原始描述: desc, 规范化结果: json.规范化回路 },
            审核状态: '已通过'
          });
        });
        loadFromSave(); renderDesktopCards(); renderRepoList();
        openSidebar(); switchTab('tabRepo');
        alert('自由回路《' + name + '》送审通过，已入自由库（一句话效果：' + effect + '）。');
      } else {
        alert('【驳回】' + (json && json.解释 ? json.解释 : '法术AI 未给出可解析结论（请重试或改描述）。'));
      }
    }).catch(function (e) {
      alert('送审失败（法术AI 不可用）：' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    });
  });

  /* 出口 B（临时强冲）已按用户要求移除：自由施法桌只保留「申报入自由库」 */

  /* ═══════════════════ 桌面切换 / 缩放平移 / 战备 ═══════════════════ */
  function switchDesk(n) {
    $('#btnNavDesk1').classList.toggle('active', n === 1);
    $('#btnNavDesk2').classList.toggle('active', n === 2);
    $('#btnNavDesk3').classList.toggle('active', n === 3);
    $('#viewportDesk1').classList.toggle('active', n === 1);
    $('#viewportDesk2').classList.toggle('active', n === 2);
    $('#viewportDesk3').classList.toggle('active', n === 3);
    if (n === 2) { renderActorBanner(); renderAffinityBoard(); }
    if (n === 3) { renderForgeControls(); recalcForgeQuote(); }
  }
  $('#btnNavDesk1').addEventListener('click', function () { switchDesk(1); });
  $('#btnNavDesk2').addEventListener('click', function () { switchDesk(2); });
  $('#btnNavDesk3').addEventListener('click', function () { switchDesk(3); });

  /* 缩放档位（固定 6 档 · zoom 重排 → 全档清晰）；平移按 zoom 折算；桌面 rotateX 倾斜，卡片反旋正视 */
  var ZOOM_LEVELS = [0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.3, 1.6, 2.0];
  function stepZoom(cur, dir) {
    var i = ZOOM_LEVELS.indexOf(cur); if (i < 0) i = 2;
    i = Math.max(0, Math.min(ZOOM_LEVELS.length - 1, i + dir));
    return ZOOM_LEVELS[i];
  }

  var zoom1 = 1.0, panX1 = 0, panY1 = 0, isPanning1 = false, startX1 = 0, startY1 = 0, origPX1 = 0, origPY1 = 0;
  function upd1() {
    surfaceDesk1.style.zoom = zoom1;
    surfaceDesk1.style.transform = 'translate(calc(-50% + ' + panX1 + 'px), calc(-50% + ' + panY1 + 'px))';
  }
  $('#viewportDesk1').addEventListener('wheel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); zoom1 = stepZoom(zoom1, e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1); upd1(); }, { passive: false });
  $('#viewportDesk1').addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    if (e.target === $('#viewportDesk1') || e.target === surfaceDesk1 || e.target.classList.contains('slot-matrix-grid')) {
      isPanning1 = true; $('#viewportDesk1').classList.add('grabbing');
      startX1 = e.clientX; startY1 = e.clientY; origPX1 = panX1; origPY1 = panY1;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    if (isPanning1) {
      panX1 = Math.max(-1200, Math.min(1200, origPX1 + (e.clientX - startX1) / zoom1));
      panY1 = Math.max(-900, Math.min(900, origPY1 + (e.clientY - startY1) / zoom1));
      upd1();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { isPanning1 = false; $('#viewportDesk1').classList.remove('grabbing'); });

  var surfaceDesk2 = $('#surfaceDesk2');
  var zoom2 = 1.0, panX2 = 0, panY2 = 0, isPanning2 = false, startX2 = 0, startY2 = 0, origPX2 = 0, origPY2 = 0;
  function upd2() {
    surfaceDesk2.style.zoom = zoom2;
    surfaceDesk2.style.transform = 'translate(calc(-50% + ' + panX2 + 'px), calc(-50% + ' + panY2 + 'px))';
  }
  $('#viewportDesk2').addEventListener('wheel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); zoom2 = stepZoom(zoom2, e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1); upd2(); }, { passive: false });
  $('#viewportDesk2').addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    if (e.target === $('#viewportDesk2') || e.target === surfaceDesk2 || e.target.classList.contains('char-profile-banner') || e.target.classList.contains('affinity-columns-grid') || e.target.classList.contains('affinity-family-col')) {
      isPanning2 = true; $('#viewportDesk2').classList.add('grabbing');
      startX2 = e.clientX; startY2 = e.clientY; origPX2 = panX2; origPY2 = panY2;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    if (isPanning2) {
      panX2 = Math.max(-1000, Math.min(1000, origPX2 + (e.clientX - startX2) / zoom2));
      panY2 = Math.max(-800, Math.min(800, origPY2 + (e.clientY - startY2) / zoom2));
      upd2();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { isPanning2 = false; $('#viewportDesk2').classList.remove('grabbing'); });

  var surfaceDesk3 = $('#surfaceDesk3');
  var zoom3 = 1.0, panX3 = 0, panY3 = 0, isPanning3 = false, startX3 = 0, startY3 = 0, origPX3 = 0, origPY3 = 0;
  function upd3() {
    surfaceDesk3.style.zoom = zoom3;
    surfaceDesk3.style.transform = 'translate(calc(-50% + ' + panX3 + 'px), calc(-50% + ' + panY3 + 'px))';
  }
  $('#viewportDesk3').addEventListener('wheel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); zoom3 = stepZoom(zoom3, e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1); upd3(); }, { passive: false });
  $('#viewportDesk3').addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    var t = e.target;
    if (t.closest && (t.closest('.forge-family-panel') || t.closest('.forge-tuning-rack') || t.closest('.forge-telemetry-hud') || t.closest('button') || t.closest('input') || t.closest('textarea'))) return;
    if (t === $('#viewportDesk3') || t === surfaceDesk3 || (t.classList && t.classList.contains('forge-layout'))) {
      isPanning3 = true; $('#viewportDesk3').classList.add('grabbing');
      startX3 = e.clientX; startY3 = e.clientY; origPX3 = panX3; origPY3 = panY3;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    if (isPanning3) {
      panX3 = Math.max(-1200, Math.min(1200, origPX3 + (e.clientX - startX3) / zoom3));
      panY3 = Math.max(-900, Math.min(900, origPY3 + (e.clientY - startY3) / zoom3));
      upd3();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { isPanning3 = false; $('#viewportDesk3').classList.remove('grabbing'); });

  var btnCombatToggle = $('#btnCombatToggle');
  function renderCombat() {
    if (isCombat) { btnCombatToggle.className = 'combat-switch combat'; btnCombatToggle.textContent = '战斗中 [槽位锁死]'; }
    else { btnCombatToggle.className = 'combat-switch'; btnCombatToggle.textContent = '非战斗 [槽位自由]'; }
  }
  btnCombatToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
    isCombat = !isCombat;
    writeGame(function (gg) { gg.主角.战斗中 = isCombat; });
    renderCombat();
  });

  /* ═══════════════════ 精神力灯光引擎（灯箱颜色随精神状态演变） ═══════════════════ */
  var currentMentalEnergy = 0;
  var maxMentalEnergy = 90;
  var LIGHT_STOPS = [
    { ratio: 1.0,  r: 56,  g: 189, b: 248 }, // 100% 满额：柔和温润天青蓝灯箱光
    { ratio: 0.65, r: 52,  g: 211, b: 153 }, // 65%  良好：清透薄荷微光
    { ratio: 0.40, r: 245, g: 158, b: 11  }, // 40%  警告：示波台琥珀金黄光
    { ratio: 0.18, r: 249, g: 115, b: 22  }, // 18%  重荷：紧迫警戒橙红光
    { ratio: 0.0,  r: 239, g: 68,  b: 68  }  // 0%   衰竭：深红血崩紧急报警光
  ];
  function interpolateColor(t) {
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    for (var i = 0; i < LIGHT_STOPS.length - 1; i++) {
      var s1 = LIGHT_STOPS[i], s2 = LIGHT_STOPS[i + 1];
      if (t <= s1.ratio && t >= s2.ratio) {
        var localT = (t - s2.ratio) / (s1.ratio - s2.ratio);
        return { r: Math.round(s2.r + (s1.r - s2.r) * localT), g: Math.round(s2.g + (s1.g - s2.g) * localT), b: Math.round(s2.b + (s1.b - s2.b) * localT) };
      }
    }
    return LIGHT_STOPS[0];
  }
  function setMentalEnergy(val) {
    if (g && g.主角 && g.主角.精神点 && g.主角.精神点.上限) maxMentalEnergy = g.主角.精神点.上限;
    currentMentalEnergy = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxMentalEnergy, val));
    var ratio = maxMentalEnergy ? currentMentalEnergy / maxMentalEnergy : 0;
    var c = interpolateColor(ratio);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--light-r', c.r);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--light-g', c.g);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--light-b', c.b);
    var fv = document.getElementById('mentalFaderVal');
    if (fv) fv.textContent = Math.round(currentMentalEnergy) + ' / ' + maxMentalEnergy;
    var vb = document.getElementById('valBurden');
    if (vb) {
      if (ratio > 0.6) { vb.textContent = '稳态 (' + Math.round(currentMentalEnergy) + '点 · 充足)'; vb.style.color = 'var(--light-primary)'; }
      else if (ratio > 0.3) { vb.textContent = '中荷 (' + Math.round(currentMentalEnergy) + '点 · 警告)'; vb.style.color = 'var(--light-primary)'; }
      else { vb.textContent = '断线警戒 (' + Math.round(currentMentalEnergy) + '点 · 剧痛)'; vb.style.color = 'var(--light-primary)'; }
    }
  }

  /* ═══════════════════ 顶部监视器刷新 ═══════════════════ */
  function renderMonitors() {
    if (!g) return;
    var zhu = g.主角;
    isCombat = !!zhu.战斗中;   // 轮询刷新也同步战斗状态（数据AI 可能在回合结算里改旗）
    $('#valBody').textContent = zhu.身体状态 || '正常';
    $('#valRes').textContent = Math.round(zhu.能量kJ.当前) + '/' + zhu.能量kJ.上限 + ' kJ · ' + Math.round(zhu.精神点.当前) + '/' + zhu.精神点.上限 + ' 精神';
    $('#valTime').textContent = zhu.剧情时间 && zhu.剧情时间.label ? zhu.剧情时间.label : '--';
    if (zhu.精神点) setMentalEnergy(zhu.精神点.当前 != null ? zhu.精神点.当前 : zhu.精神点.上限);
    renderCombat();
  }

  /* ═══════════════════ 初始化 ═══════════════════ */
  function init() {
    if (!loadFromSave()) {
      document.getElementById('gdesk').innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:400px;color:#64748b;font-size:13px;">尚未开局：请先完成渐变带开局。</div>';
      return;
    }
    renderMonitors();
    buildSlots();
    computeSocketAnchors();   // 槽位锚点写死：进槽卡固定坐标，缩放/平移不漂移
    renderDesktopCards();
    renderRepoList();
    renderDesktopSupplyCards();
    renderSupplyList();
    renderActorBanner();
    renderAffinityBoard();
    renderPresetButtons();
    updateEnergyCap();
    if (!FORGE_STATE.c) FORGE_STATE.c = E.initParams(FORGE_STATE.fam);
    renderForgeControls();
    recalcForgeQuote();
    openSidebar();
    upd1(); upd2(); upd3();
    // 槽位锚点写死：只在布局变化时重算（面板尺寸 / 槽位容器尺寸 / 字体加载完成）
    // 字体 swap 会使 meta/按钮行高变化、well 垂直位移 1~2px → fonts.ready 后补算一次，修掉残余偏差
    function refreshSocketAnchors() { computeSocketAnchors(); renderDesktopCards(); }
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      new ResizeObserver(refreshSocketAnchors).observe($('#viewportDesk1'));
      new ResizeObserver(refreshSocketAnchors).observe($('#slotsContainer'));
    }
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(refreshSocketAnchors);
    }
    // 轻量周期刷新：监视器 + 精神辉光灯光随游戏内精神变化（不重建卡片，不打断拖拽）
    setInterval(function () {
      var fresh = readChat();
      if (fresh && fresh.主角) { g = fresh; renderMonitors(); }
    }, 10000);
  }
  init();
})();
